cn.title: Leapmotor China
cn.description: Experimental: read-only vehicle data. No vehicle controls.

cn_phone.title: China: phone number
cn_phone.description: Mainland number, optionally prefixed with +86 or 0086. This step does not send an SMS. Optional: http://username:password@host:port. Empty means direct connection. Proxy failures never fall back to direct access.

cn_send_sms.title: Request SMS code
cn_send_sms.description: Check the box and submit to request an SMS. If the result is uncertain, check for delivery first; there is no automatic retry.

cn_code.title: Enter SMS code
cn_code.description: Enter the code including leading zeroes. This step never requests another SMS.

cn_import.title: China: import session
cn_import.description: Expert option. Session data contains secret credentials; do not share it. Optional: http://username:password@host:port. Empty means direct connection. Proxy failures never fall back to direct access.

error.account_cert_error: Login succeeded, but the account certificate could not be opened.
error.api_refresh_failed: Login worked, but the initial vehicle data refresh failed.
error.no_vehicle: Login worked, but no vehicle is available for this account.
error.sms_request_failed: SMS request failed or outcome uncertain. Check delivery; wait at least 60 seconds before retrying.

abort.reauth_not_supported: This reauthentication flow is not available for this region.

cn_init.title: CN proxy
cn_init.description: Optional: http://username:password@host:port. Empty means direct connection. Proxy failures never fall back to direct access.
